fact: The World Bank mission reports a System Integrator contracted with INIC and DGRN to design and implement a new foundational digital ID, with launch planned by January 2026 and its enabling identity law still awaiting approval.
A Justice Ministry official says the country is in the pilot phase of a national digital ID on MOSIP, begun in 2024, with no fixed timeline for full-scale deployment.

fact: A tender notice of 14 May 2026 by AFAP seeks servers for the data centre and disaster recovery of the digital identity system.
A campaign running until 15 March 2026 gave a free Bilhete de Identidade to citizens over 17 without a valid one, implemented by the Direcao-Geral dos Registos e Notariado with PReSE support.

The Direcao-Geral dos Registos e Notariado is issuing the free Bilhete de Identidade through a brigade in Porto Alegre, Caue district, after Ilheu das Rolas, with EU-funded PReSE supplying Starlink and a generator.
The AFAP, under the World Bank-financed Sao Tome and Principe Digital project, announced a tender for biometric kits for digital identity registration.
